analogy.rationale: ADCY1 is broadly expressed, but inhibiting cAMP synthesis produces modest transcriptional changes in these cell lines; the closest reference classes are those acting on the same cAMP axis (activator, phosphodiesterase inhibitor) or upstream GPCR/adenosine receptors, while guanylate cyclase activator is a parallel cyclic-nucleotide pathway.
